children: Saudi Civil Defense said an attack by Yemen's Houthi movement in Tuwwal County, Jazan Province, injured two people and damaged several buildings and some vehicles. According to Sina Finance, the agency said the attack on civilian targets was a blatant violation of international humanitarian law and that the matter had been handled under established procedures. The Houthi movement said Saudi warplanes carried out 129 airstrikes across seven Yemeni provinces in the past 48 hours and warned that the strikes would not go unanswered or unpunished.

title: Saudi Civil Defense Says Houthi Attack in Jazan Injures Two
